name: Maybank XL Cashback Card
annual_fee_note: S$ | First 2 Years Waived; Subsequent annual fee will be automatically waived with a minimum spend of S$6,000 yearly.

percent:baseline.note: 0.2% unlimited cashback (1x TREATS Points) for all other spend.

highlights: 5% cashback on Dine, Shop, Travel and Play categories + FCY spend (overseas & online), unlocked with min. S$500 spend per calendar month, capped at S$80 per calendar month. All other spend at 0.2% unlimited cashback.
pros: 5% cashback* whenever you spend in the Dine, Shop, Travel and Play categories, as well as in Foreign currencies.
pros: Up to S$80 bonus cashback monthly (Other transactions will earn unlimited cashback at 0.2% cashback.)

pros: Credit Cards with one of the widest number of spending categories in the market:
Dine: Restaurants, fast food, bakeries, food delivery, etc.
Shop: Apparel, departmental stores, sports apparel, online shopping, etc.
Travel: Airlines, online travel agencies, hotel booking, etc.
Play: Bars, KTV, cinemas, online streaming, video game arcade, etc.
+all foreign currency spend (overseas & online)
cons: Extremely limited age range (21 to 39 years old only).
cons: 5% bonus cashback rate requires S$500 min. spend per calendar month.

sign_up_offers.title: Maybank Welcome Offer

gifts.title: Get an increased S$100 Cashback Cap

sign_up_offers.terms:
Welcome Offer promotion is valid from 1 July 2026 to 30 September 2026.
Promotion is valid for new Maybank credit cardmembers only.
Apply and get approved for the Maybank XL Cashback Card within the promo period and meet the min. monthly spend requirement to unlock an increased 
S$100 bonus cashback cap
 per calendar month (instead of S$80) for 3 months starting from the month of card approval.
Terms and Conditions
 apply.

extra.description: Make the most of your best years with the Maybank XL Cashback Card. With a whopping 5% cashback on foreign currency spend and one of the widest number of spending categories on the market, you can score extra large rewards whenever you Dine, Shop, Travel, and Play.
